# Ruby Gillis

deceased · [Queen’s Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy)

## Overview

- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s P1](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0001), [v3 ch.Life P4](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0004), [v3 ch.Summons P31](../source/v03-c14.md#nw-v03-c14-p0031)</sub>
- **Role:** teacher (since v2)  <sub>[v2 XIX Just a Happy Day P60](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0060), [v3 ch.Life P6](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0006)</sub>
- **Status:** deceased (since v3)  <sub>[v3 ch.Summons P30](../source/v03-c14.md#nw-v03-c14-p0030), [v3 ch.Anne-girl P3](../source/v03-c18.md#nw-v03-c18-p0003)</sub>
- **Family:** [Susan](../character/susan.md) (sibling)

## Appearance

Ruby Gillis is characterized by her showy looks, featuring large, bright-blue eyes, a brilliant complexion, and a plump figure, alongside a long braid of golden hair. Over time, her appearance changes significantly as she becomes very thin, with delicate, almost transparent hands. Her blue eyes take on a bright and lustrous quality, while the color in her cheeks becomes hectically brilliant.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P28](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0028), [v1 CHAPTER XXX. The Queen’s Class Is Organized P43](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0043), [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s P1](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0001), [v3 ch.Autumn P4](../source/v03-c02.md#nw-v03-c02-p0004), [v3 ch.Life P4](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0004)_

## Personality

Ruby Gillis is a cheerful and good-tempered individual who enjoys the pleasant things in life, though she can be inclined to go into hysterics and holds a mortal dread of fat green caterpillars. Highly conscious of boys, she is heavily preoccupied with romance, frequently boasting about her admirers and suitors. Since childhood, her goal has been to have numerous beaus crazy about her and to enjoy a gay time before settling down. To this end, she intends to teach for only two years after finishing her education before getting married.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P39](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0039), [v1 CHAPTER XVIII. ## History

Ruby Gillis grew up alongside [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), attending school and Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy) with her. She also joined [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md), and [Jane](../character/jane-andrews.md) in dramatizing Elaine, a game that went awry when their flat leaked and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) had to be rescued. After spending time in [Boston](../codex/places.md#boston), Ruby's health began to fail due to illness, though she attempted to hide her decline behind a facade of gaiety when [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) visited her. During a quiet evening spent with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), Ruby tearfully confessed her fear of dying and leaving her life behind. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) comforted her, and shortly after their conversation, Ruby passed away peacefully in her sleep.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXVIII. An Unfortunate Lily Maid P11](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0011), [v1 CHAPTER XXVIII. An Unfortunate Lily Maid P18](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0018), [v1 CHAPTER XXVIII. An Unfortunate Lily Maid P23](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0023), [v1 CHAPTER XXVIII. ## Quotes

> ““Nor I,” said Ruby Gillis, with a shiver. “I don’t mind floating down when there’s two or three of us in the flat and we can sit up. It’s fun then. But to lie down and pretend I was dead—I just couldn’t. I’d die really of fright.”
>
> — Ruby Gillis — [v1 CHAPTER XXVIII. An Unfortunate Lily Maid P1](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0001)

> "Anne, it won’t be long now before I’ll be lying over there. You and Diana and all the rest will be going about, full of life—and I’ll be there—in the old graveyard—dead!"
>
> — Ruby Gillis — [v3 ch.Summons P7](../source/v03-c14.md#nw-v03-c14-p0007)

> "I’ll try. I’ll think over what you have said, and try to believe it. And you’ll come up as often as you can, won’t you, Anne?"
>
> — Ruby Gillis — [v3 ch.Summons P21](../source/v03-c14.md#nw-v03-c14-p0021)

> "There’s a concert at Carmody and a party at White Sands. Herb Spencer’s going to take me. He’s my latest. Be sure to come up tomorrow. I’m dying for a good talk with you. I want to hear all about your doings at Redmond."
>
> — Ruby Gillis — [v3 ch.Life P8](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0008)

> "Me! Why, I’m perfectly well. I never felt better in my life. Of course, that congestion last winter pulled me down a little. But just see my color. I don’t look much like an invalid, I’m sure."
>
> — Ruby Gillis — [v3 ch.Life P57](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0057)
